data.name: screenshot
data.description: Capture a screenshot of the Unity editor. Views: scene, game.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: View to capture: scene (default), game

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Override width (default 1920)

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Override height (default 1080)

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Output file path, absolute or relative to project root (default: Screenshots/screenshot.png)

data.name: exec
data.description: Execute arbitrary C# code at runtime. Full access to Unity and all loaded assemblies.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: C# code to execute. Use 'return' for output.

parameters.name: usings
parameters.description: Additional using directives (comma-separated, e.g. Unity.Entities,Unity.Mathematics)

parameters.name: csc
parameters.description: Path to csc compiler (csc.dll or csc.exe). Auto-detected if omitted.

parameters.name: dotnet
parameters.description: Path to dotnet runtime. Auto-detected if omitted.

data.name: menu
data.description: Execute a Unity menu item by path.

parameters.name: menu_path
parameters.description: Unity menu item path to execute (e.g. File/Save Project)

data.name: manage_editor
data.description: Controls Unity editor state. Actions: play, stop, pause, refresh, set_active_tool, add_tag, remove_tag, add_layer, remove_layer.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action to perform: play, stop, pause, refresh, set_active_tool, add_tag, remove_tag, add_layer, remove_layer

parameters.name: wait_for_completion
parameters.description: Wait for action to complete before responding

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: Tool name (required for set_active_tool action)

parameters.name: tag_name
parameters.description: Tag name (required for add_tag/remove_tag actions)

parameters.name: layer_name
parameters.description: Layer name (required for add_layer/remove_layer actions)

data.name: profiler
data.description: Control Unity Profiler. Actions: hierarchy, enable, disable, status, clear.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action: hierarchy, enable, disable, status, or clear

parameters.name: frame
parameters.description: Frame index. -1 or omit = last captured frame.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start frame index for range average.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End frame index for range average.

parameters.name: frames
parameters.description: Number of recent frames to average (shortcut for range).

parameters.name: thread
parameters.description: Thread index. 0 = main thread.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Parent item ID to drill into. Omit for root level.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Find item by name and use as root. Substring match.

parameters.name: min
parameters.description: Minimum total time (ms) filter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort column: 'total', 'self', or 'calls'. Default 'total'.

parameters.name: max
parameters.description: Max children per level. Default 30.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Recursive depth. 1 = one level (default), 0 = unlimited.

data.name: console
data.description: Read or clear Unity console logs.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated log types: error, warning, log. Default: error,warning,log

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Maximum number of log entries to return

parameters.name: stacktrace
parameters.description: Stack trace mode: none (first line), user (user code frames only), full (raw). Default: user

parameters.name: clear
parameters.description: Clear console

data.name: refresh_unity
data.description: Refresh Unity assets and optionally request script compilation.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Refresh mode: if_dirty (default) or force

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Allow refresh while the editor is in or entering play mode.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Scope: all (default) or specific path

parameters.name: compile
parameters.description: Compile mode: none (default) or request

data.name: reserialize
data.description: Force reserialize Unity assets. No params = entire project.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Single asset path to reserialize

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Multiple asset paths to reserialize

data.name: run_tests
data.description: Run Unity EditMode or PlayMode tests and return results.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Test mode: EditMode or PlayMode

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter by namespace, class, or full test name

parameters.name: allow_dirty_scenes
parameters.description: Run tests even when open scenes have unsaved changes

parameters.name: auto_save_scenes
parameters.description: Save dirty open scenes before running tests
